notes:
Faster downloads, real memory detection, Minecraft heads, a calmer look, and the launcher in English and French.

- Cosmoria downloads are much faster: up to 8 files at once, each still checked (size and SHA-256) before use.
  Short network hiccups are retried automatically; a damaged file never is.
- Memory: the launcher now reads your PC's real RAM, and the memory slider goes as high as your PC can safely give
  (up to 32 GB). A saved value above that is brought back within the limit.
- Your Minecraft head: the account shows the head of your official skin (hat layer included), kept for offline
  use. Offline profiles can use a skin file of your own; without a skin, Steve is shown.
- Offline profiles can be deleted (with a confirmation). Your worlds, screenshots and game files stay.
- Signing in again with the same Microsoft account cleans up older offline entries for that same player: no more
  duplicate or stuck "Locked" line.
- Settings are organised by category: General, Game, Java, Accounts, Updates.
- A calmer, more desktop look, with a new consistent set of icons.
- English and French: the launcher follows your Windows language the first time, and you can switch at any time in
  Settings > General. Home news are shown in your language.
- A Cosmoria channel with nothing published yet now says so, instead of reporting a network problem.
